'''Triffis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Triffis system/Legends|Triffis system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="EAOC" /> along the [[Duros Space Run]]<ref name="TEA" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Triffian/Legends|Triffians]], including [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] pilot [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe E. Endocott]]<ref name="DB" /><ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Eelen Li]].<ref name="DP" />

==History==
{{Quote|Exquisite.''"<br />"''Quite. A gift from Senator Eelen Li.''"<br />"''From Triffis.''"<br />"''A museum piece, actually.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], about a [[Unidentified Triffian carving|Triffian carving]]|<ref name="DP" />}}
By the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Triffis was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by Senator Eelen Li. A few time before that event, she gave Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] a near-prehistoric [[Unidentified Triffian carving|Triffian stone carving]] from [[Unidentified Triffian museum|one]] of Triffis's museums. Palpatine kept it in his [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartments]] in [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]].<ref name="FF32" /><ref name="DP" />

The planet remained neutral during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref>
